title: "SUPPA2 Analysis"

Make SUPPA2 Analysis folder:

```{bash, make-suppa-folder}
mkdir -p suppa_analysis
cd suppa_analysis
# download gencode annotation
wget -q -O gencode.v29.annotation.gtf.gz ftp://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/Gencode_human/release_29/gencode.v29.annotation.gtf.gz
gunzip -f gencode.v29.annotation.gtf.gz
```

Load Isoform Quantifications:

```{r, load-isoform-quants}
# read the file table
download_metadata <- fread("processed_data/file_table.csv.gz")
# get the isoform quantification files
isoform_files <- download_metadata[assay_type == "RNA-Seq", file.path(rna_data_dir, basename(file_path))]
cols_to_keep <- c("transcript_id", "gene_id", "effective_length", "expected_count", "TPM")
# load the isoform quantification files
iso_quants_list <- pbmcapply::pbmclapply(isoform_files, data.table::fread, stringsAsFactor = TRUE, fill = TRUE, select = cols_to_keep)

names(iso_quants_list) <- download_metadata[assay_type == "RNA-Seq", uuid]

# make one isoform quantification table
isoform_quants <- data.table::rbindlist(iso_quants_list, idcol = "uuid")
isoform_quants[, uuid := as.factor(uuid)]
tpms <- isoform_quants[download_metadata[assay_type == "RNA-Seq", .(uuid, epirr_id_without_version, experiment_type)], on = .(uuid), c("experiment_type", "epirr_id_without_version") := .(experiment_type, epirr_id_without_version)][, .(tpm = sum(TPM)), by = .(uuid, epirr_id_without_version, experiment_type)]
ggplot(tpms, aes(x = tpm, fill = experiment_type)) +
  geom_histogram()
```

```{r, filter-annotation}
# load annotation file
unfiltered_annotation <- rtracklayer::import("suppa_analysis/gencode.v29.annotation.gtf")

valid_biotypes <- c(
  "protein_coding", "lincRNA", "processed_transcript",
  "antisense", "sense_intronic", "sense_overlapping",
  "retained_intron", "transcribed_unprocessed_pseudogene"
)
tx_filtered <- unfiltered_annotation[
  unfiltered_annotation$type == "transcript" &
    unfiltered_annotation$transcript_type %in% valid_biotypes &
    unfiltered_annotation$transcript_support_level %in% c("1", "2")
]
tx_filtered_basic <- tx_filtered[!is.na(tx_filtered$tag) & tx_filtered$tag == "basic"]

tx_filter_list <- list(
  filtered = tx_filtered,
  basic = tx_filtered_basic
)

for (tx_filter_name in names(tx_filter_list)) {
  tx_filter <- tx_filter_list[[tx_filter_name]]

  # filter the annotation
  annotation <- unfiltered_annotation[unfiltered_annotation$transcript_id %in% tx_filter$transcript_id]
  # filter autosomes
  standard_chroms <- paste0("chr", c(1:22))
  annotation <- annotation[seqnames(annotation) %in% standard_chroms]
  # export filtered annotation
  gtf_file <- paste0("gencode.v29.", tx_filter_name, ".gtf")
  rtracklayer::export(annotation, file.path("suppa_analysis", gtf_file))

  # filter for transcripts
  isoform_quants_filtered <- isoform_quants[transcript_id %in% annotation$transcript_id]
  print(ggplot(isoform_quants_filtered[, .(tpm = sum(TPM)), by = .(uuid, epirr_id_without_version, experiment_type)], aes(x = tpm, fill = experiment_type)) +
    geom_histogram() +
    labs(title = tx_filter_name))

  # recompute TPM values on the transcripts
  isoform_quants_filtered[effective_length > 0, RPK := 1000 * expected_count / effective_length, by = .(uuid, epirr_id_without_version)]
  isoform_quants_filtered[, TPM := 1000000 * RPK / sum(RPK, na.rm = TRUE), by = .(uuid, epirr_id_without_version)]
  isoform_quants_filtered[is.na(TPM), TPM := 0]
  print(ggplot(isoform_quants_filtered[, .(tpm = sum(TPM)), by = .(uuid, epirr_id_without_version, experiment_type)], aes(x = tpm, fill = experiment_type)) +
    geom_histogram() +
    labs(title = tx_filter_name))

  # compute and export the gene expression in TPM by summing up transcript TPMS
  gene_quants <- isoform_quants_filtered[, .(gene_tpm = sum(TPM, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(uuid, epirr_id_without_version, gene_id)]
  gene_expr_file <- paste0("suppa_analysis/gene_expressions_", tx_filter_name, ".rds")
  saveRDS(gene_quants, gene_expr_file)

  # bring tpms to wide format
  tpm_dt <- data.table::dcast(isoform_quants_filtered, transcript_id ~ uuid, value.var = "TPM", fill = 0)

  # export expression for analysis with suppa
  suppa_expr_filename <- paste0("suppa_analysis/tpm_expressions_", tx_filter_name, ".tsv")
  fileConn <- file(suppa_expr_filename)
  writeLines(paste(names(tpm_dt)[-1], collapse = "\t"), fileConn)
  close(fileConn)
  fwrite(tpm_dt, suppa_expr_filename, sep = "\t", append = TRUE)
}
```


Actual SUPPA2 analysis:

```{bash, engine.opts="-l", eval=FALSE, conda-env}
conda env create -f env.yml
```

```{bash, engine.opts="-l", runSUPPA}
cd suppa_analysis
conda activate ihec-as
for suffix in filtered basic
do
    expr_file=tpm_expressions_${suffix}.tsv
    dir_path=events_${suffix}
    mkdir -p ${dir_path}
    suppa.py generateEvents -i gencode.v29.${suffix}.gtf -o ${dir_path}/gencode.v29.${suffix}.events -f ioe -e SE SS MX RI FL --pool-genes
    for event in SE A5 A3 MX RI AF AL
    do 
        suppa.py psiPerEvent -i ${dir_path}/gencode.v29.${suffix}.events_${event}_strict.ioe -e ${expr_file} -o ${dir_path}/event_${event} -m INFO -f 1 --save_tpm_events
    done
done
```
